notes.title: New Features & Fixes Added!
notes.content:
In-Game Quest Progress Tracker

Quests are now displayed as text on the left side of your screen for easy tracking at all times.



Permanent Items Update
Items purchased from the Main Base will remain permanent ONLY if the quest is successfully completed.
Details:
[olist]
 Permanent items apply only to the Lobby Owner (Server).
 If the game is interrupted or the quest is not completed, previously purchased items for the Lobby Owner will be lost.
 Guest Players (Clients) will not retain purchased items after the game ends. All prompts will be deleted upon game completion.
 Refunds for spent money have been removed accordingly.
 Items purchased from the Truck while in the game are instant-use only and not permanent.
[/olist]


Bug Fixes
Fixed the floating ghost problem in the Main Base.
Resolved the control issue with the Hell Bridge.

 

Gameplay Improvements
Improved the probability of encountering the event ghost Krampus during gameplay.

 

🎮 Enjoy the new updates and keep surviving! 🔥

notes.title: 🎄Merry Christmas🎄
notes.content:
Seasonal Christmas Update 

Christmas Update Highlights
Christmas has arrived on maps! Experience the festive atmosphere with seasonal decorations.
A new ghost has been added exclusively for the Christmas season: "Krampus"!
Catch it now and add it to your ghost collection before it's gone on January 10th.
Christmas music has been added to the main base for a jolly experience.

Permanent In-Game Updates:
You can now open/close doors with the "E" key for easier interactions.
The Key Assignment System is here! Customize your control keys to suit your play style.
A Difficulty Multiplier has been added to the game rewards system:
Earn more rewards for playing more difficult games!
New Sounds have been added:
Background sounds have been improved for an enhanced gaming experience.

What's Coming Next?
We are actively working on:
Refining sounds and audio effects.
Improving events and ghost behaviors.

Stay tuned for a more bug-free and immersive gameplay experience very soon!

Enjoy the festive update and have fun catching Krampus! 🎅👻

notes.title: 🎃 Halloween Update🎃
notes.content:
Happy Halloween🎃, players!

We’re thrilled to introduce our Halloween update, bringing spooky new features and improvements to the game:


 New Ghost - "Hollow Howl": Encounter the new ghost, Hollow Howl, in the game during the Halloween event. Good luck catching it!
 Protective Item Range Adjusted: The working distance for protective items has been shortened.
 Ghost Interaction Fix: Fixed bugs in the ghosts’ item-burning and item-flying mechanics.
 Radar Update: Fetuses can now be seen on the radar in red, making it easier to track and hunt them.
 Flashlight Toggle: You can now turn your flashlight on and off with the "F" key while holding another item.
 Expanded Device Purchase: Up to 4 devices (such as Thermometer, Radar, and EMF) can now be purchased.
 Automatic Reconnect for Clients: If clients are kicked from the game due to connection issues, they will automatically reconnect.
 Ping Warning Notification: If you experience high ping, a warning notification will appear in the upper right corner.


Enjoy the Halloween update, and stay safe hunting Hollow Howl! As always, if you encounter any issues or have feedback, let us know.

Happy Haunting!

notes.title: Update - Version 0.0.0.108
notes.content:
Dear players,

We’re happy to announce the release of version 0.0.0.108, which brings several fixes and improvements:


 Item Dropping and Pickup: Issues related to item dropping, picking up, and disappearing have been resolved.
 Preview Item Placement: The problem of not being able to place preview items has been fixed.
 Fetus Behavior Improvements: Further improvements have been made to fetus behaviors.
 Ghost Position in Main Base: The position of the ghost in the 14th Capsule in the main base has been corrected.
 Item Teleportation to Truck: Fixed issues where items were not teleporting correctly to the Truck when someone died.
 Camera Photo Issue: Resolved the issue where photos taken with the camera were visible in the next game and disrupted the system.
 Microphone Settings Fix: The problem with microphone settings has been solved. Now, the last change you made is remembered, and the microphone continues to work with that setting.
 Return to Base Screen: A new Return to Base screen has been added to the Truck, allowing you to collect your rewards and return to the main base at any time.
 Minor Visual and Bug Fixes: Various minor visual issues and other small bugs have been addressed.


Thank you for your continued feedback and support! If you encounter any issues, don’t hesitate to reach out.

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Bug Fix Update - Version 0.0.0.105
notes.content:
Whats up Ghost hunters!

We’re rolling out another bug fix update with version 0.0.0.105. The following issues have been addressed:


 Fetus Behavior Improvements: Enhanced the behaviors of the fetus.
 Spirit Seeker Bug: Fixed an issue where the Spirit Seeker sometimes acted broken.
 Mouse Sensitivity: Adjusted and fixed mouse sensitivity issues.
 Cat Behavior Bug: Fixed an issue where the cat sometimes acted broken.
 Mansion Map Visual Errors: Resolved visual errors in the Mansion map.
 Minor Bug Fixes: Addressed some additional minor errors.


Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Game Update - Version 0.0.0.103
notes.content:
Dear players,

We’re excited to announce the release of our 3rd update! Here's a list of improvements and fixes included in version 0.0.0.103:




Invisible Items Fixed: Solved issues where certain items (e.g., the Ouija board) were not visible in the camera.

Camera & Photo Camera Bug: Fixed problems related to the purchased camera and photo camera.

New Purchase Screen Info: Added current level and money information to the in-game purchase screen.

Screen Glitch Fixes: Addressed screen glitches in some rooms on the Mansion and School maps.

Ghost Stuck Issue Resolved: Fixed the ghost getting stuck in the Manor map, as well as the issue where players got stuck when pulled by the ghost.

Improved Item Disappearance: Enhanced the handling of item disappearance in the game.

Cursor Stuck Issue: Fixed the issue where the cursor would get stuck when switching from the game to another screen.

Movement Speed After Death: Increased movement speed when playing as a ghost after dying.

Item Pickup Bug: Resolved the problem where items that fell to the ground could not be picked up again.

Sanity Adjustments: Made balancing adjustments to the loss of sanity.
Item Placement Improved: Enhanced the placement of items with preview mode.


If you experience any other problems, do not hesitate to let us know. We will fix the problems as quickly as possible and we are always listening to your feedback.

notes.title: Ghostbane Demo is Out..!
notes.content:
Ghostbane's demo is now available on Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718515/bfabfcba85849af7fb6f9fb66153a263f73e6fb3.jpg

Dear Ghostbane Hunters,

The Ghostbane demo is now available for Steam. You can experience single player gameplay in the demo version. Our goal is to give you a first impression of the game and get your feedback on Ghostbane. In the demo content, you will be able to observe the general progress of the game and contribute to the development process. Your experience may be affected by various bugs and performance issues you may encounter during this phase. You can contact us via the Discord server if you experience any problems.

Ghostbane demo at Steam Next Fest on February 5th

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718515/125ff60f69d82ab8fbbf52be3a2b0482f2f4e651.jpg

Ghostbane demo at Steam Next Fest on February 5th. You can give us your feedback during the event and contribute to the development of the game.

What will be in Full Version?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718515/9a6bb1d3dd8902806c2ab99d8f140f9e65053386.png

Here are some of the features we are aiming to achieve in the Full Version:


 Multiplayer gameplay.
 More than 10 game maps and more interactive elements.
 More than 20 different ghost types and unique extra features.
 Various game modes and exciting additional quests.
 Brand new upgradeable items.
 Advanced AI elements focused on voice communication with ghosts. We'll give you a very different experience than you're used to.
 Customizable and upgradeable Master top, equipment and ghosts.
 In-game emote animations.
 Fun little games.
 Language support and enhancements.
 Steam achievements, score shop and workshop integrations.
 And much more to add based on your feedback.
